name: GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress
description:
GoPublish is a WordPress export, schedule and publishing connector for moving finished content from Claude to self-hosted WordPress.org sites. 

GoPublish requires no plugin, WordPress.com account, Jetpack connection, code changes, or direct database access. It connects through a revocable WordPress Application Password approved by the user

It can publish your content from Claude to WordPress as a draft, pending review, private item, live post, or scheduled post.  It support the export to WordPress as a post, page, or custom post type using Gutenberg blocks or Classic HTML. 

It can fetch categories, tags, and custom taxonomies; set SEO meta titles and descriptions; and upload  featured or inline images; and compress images during upload.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gopublish.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress provides these MCP tools: export_to_wordpress, get_wordpress_export_capabilities, list_wordpress_sites, list_wordpress_terms, manage_wordpress_connections, prepare_wordpress_export, and upload_wordpress_image.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoPublish: Publish & Schedule to WordPress is developed by GoPublish. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
